title: Flamingo with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <line x1="45" y1="72" x2="42" y2="92" stroke="#FF6B9D" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="55" y1="72" x2="58" y2="92" stroke="#FF6B9D" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Feet -->
  <path d="M38 92 L46 92" stroke="#FF6B9D" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M54 92 L62 92" stroke="#FF6B9D" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="22" ry="16" fill="#FF8FB1"/>
  <!-- Wing highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="46" cy="60" rx="12" ry="8" fill="#FFB3CC"/>
  <!-- Tail feathers -->
  <path d="M70 58 Q78 52 76 60 Q80 55 80 63 Q74 68 68 66Z" fill="#FF6B9D"/>
  <!-- Neck -->
  <path d="M36 58 Q30 40 34 28 Q36 20 44 18" stroke="#FF8FB1" stroke-width="8" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx="48" cy="19" r="10" fill="#FF8FB1"/>
  <!-- Beak -->
  <path d="M55 20 Q64 22 62 27 Q58 26 55 25Z" fill="#FFCF5C"/>
  <path d="M55 25 Q62 27 62 27" stroke="#D99A2B" stroke-width="0.8" fill="none"/>
  <!-- Eye white -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="17" r="3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- Eye pupil -->
  <circle cx="50.5" cy="17" r="1.8" fill="#2B1B3D"/>
  <!-- Sparkle 1 (big) -->
  <path d="M50.5 13.5 L51.2 15.8 L53.5 16.5 L51.2 17.2 L50.5 19.5 L49.8 17.2 L47.5 16.5 L49.8 15.8Z" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- Sparkle 2 (small) -->
  <path d="M53 15 L53.3 15.9 L54.2 16.2 L53.3 16.5 L53 17.4 L52.7 16.5 L51.8 16.2 L52.7 15.9Z" fill="#FFF8C0"/>
  <!-- Sparkle 3 -->
  <path d="M48 19 L48.2 19.6 L48.8 19.8 L48.2 20 L48 20.6 L47.8 20 L47.2 19.8 L47.8 19.6Z" fill="#FFF8C0"/>
</svg>
